pending_commit.commit_message: UPSTREAM: drivers/spi: be sure to call spi_init() before spi_flash_probe() It's necessary to call spi_init() prior to calling spi_flash_probe() such that the SPI drivers can do any work required prior to performing SPI transactions. It could be argued that the drivers should handle such situations, however the SPI API implementations seem to assume the callers ensured spi_init() was called before any SPI transactions. This fixes systems that failed to boot introduced by [1]. Issue tracked in https://ticket.coreboot.org/issues/67. libcontainer: Separate cgroup configuration from creation This adds the ability to set the owner of the parent cgroups, this is needed when entering a cgroup namespace as the subdirectories and their files must be owned by the user that root maps to outside the container. Move cgroup creation from where the config is created until later. This information isn't known by login manager when creating the container. Moving it later allows it to be configured like other config options. BUG=none TEST=run with dependent changes and see that the cgroup is created with the correct owner and at the correct place in the cgroup hierarchy. Change-Id: Ia31fb7eebe562b36216ce547c9889bcffba7f257 Signed-off-by: Dylan Reid <dgreid@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/362097 Reviewed-by: Eric Caruso <ejcaruso@chromium.org>

login: Set cgroup parent directory for android containers Android will now run in a new cgroup namespace. This will allow it to modify its own cgroups while not knowing that it is part of a larger cgroup hierarchy. Configure the external cgroup "session_manager_containers" that will be the root of Android's cgroup namespace. BUG=b/29259708 TEST=Start android and check that it is in a new cgroup namespace rooted at session_manager_containers. Change-Id: Ic361c2cf0904d05b959fad51c53b2fd983b22bc9 Signed-off-by: Dylan Reid <dgreid@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/362099 Reviewed-by: Dan Erat <derat@chromium.org>

libcontainer: Run containers in a cgroup namespace Now that all of our supported kernels support cgroup namespaces, enable them when running a container. This will allow the container to modify cgroup parameters for sub groups but still allows the system to control overall limits. The contained processes will not know that it is in a cgroup namespace, it appears as the root inside the namespace. BUG=b/29259708 TEST=boot android on cyan and check cgroup membership inside and outside the container. Change-Id: I83e93ea6135f2b3f4baa4816eacacd1e02f1986a Signed-off-by: Dylan Reid <dgreid@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/362350

cr50: remove internal pull up on DIOM0 There is leakage on SYS_RST_ODL from the internal pullup cr50 has on DIOM0. This change removes the internal pullup. Without the internal pull up SYS_RST_ODL is not pulled up whenever the EC is off. I changed how sys_rst_asserted is handled so it will ignore the sys_rst interrupt whenever rbox asserts EC_RST to make sure cr50 doesn't reset itself every time it resets the EC. If the EC resets itself and sys_rst_l is no longer pulled up, it is fine if cr50 resets. BUG=chrome-os-partner:53544 BRANCH=none TEST=manual 'rw 0x40550010 1' causes the EC to reset but not cr50 On the development board verify DIOM0 is not pulled up. Test cr50 boots normally on reef and gru Change-Id: Ic1d4d160ddb0d69081cb1f194d50939dac6fc5c2 Signed-off-by: Mary Ruthven <mruthven@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/373838 Reviewed-by: Bill Richardson <wfrichar@chromium.org>
